title: Ibrance: from patient selection to monitoring

scenes.title: Confirm the treatment setting
scenes.narration: Begin with an adult patient with HR-positive, HER2-negative advanced or metastatic breast cancer and confirm the labeled combination setting.
scenes.visual: A simple patient-identification pathway highlighting receptor status and disease stage.

scenes.title: Explain the 28-day schedule
scenes.narration: The recommended starting dose is 125 milligrams once daily for 21 consecutive days, followed by 7 days off treatment.
scenes.visual: A 28-day calendar with treatment Days 1–21 and rest Days 22–28.

scenes.title: Plan CBC monitoring
scenes.narration: Monitor complete blood counts before treatment, at the beginning of each cycle, on Day 15 of the first two cycles, and as clinically indicated.
scenes.visual: The calendar adds CBC markers at baseline, cycle start, and Day 15 of Cycles 1 and 2.

scenes.title: Act on pulmonary symptoms
scenes.narration: If interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis is suspected, interrupt Ibrance immediately and evaluate the patient. The label directs permanent discontinuation for severe cases.
scenes.visual: A symptom-to-action pathway showing interruption, evaluation, and severe-case discontinuation.

scenes.title: Bring the care plan together
scenes.narration: Confirm the labeled patient, explain the schedule, plan blood-count monitoring, and make the pulmonary safety response clear before treatment begins.
scenes.visual: A four-item clinical checklist completes around the patient pathway.
